Business Rosenblatt Securities Analysts Give Apple (AAPL) a $180.00 Price Target 
Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a report released on Wednesday morning. The firm currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
A number of other research analysts have also recently issued reports on the stock. Citigroup restated a buy rating and set a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 13th. Bank of America cut shares of Apple from a buy rating to a neutral rating and upped their price target for the company from $180.00 to $220.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 17th. Cascend Securities upped their price target on shares of Apple from $200.00 to $220.00 and gave the company a buy rating in a report on Monday, January 29th. Morgan Stanley reiterated a buy rating and issued a $205.00 price target (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 23rd. Finally, KeyCorp reiterated a buy rating and issued a $192.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. The company presently has an average rating of Buy and an average price target of $202.62. 
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL opened at $167.78 on Wednesday. The company has a market cap of $851,317.94, a P/E ratio of 18.22, a PEG ratio of 1.27 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a 52-week low of $140.06 and a 52-week high of $183.50.
